1: Chapter 1: A Visitor on a Rainy Night
The rain in Qingshi had lasted three full days. Lin Xiaoyu’s sister had left for the capital in the spring, and since then, the small apothecary in town had been left in her care alone.
After dark, she locked the doors and windows, counted the day’s earnings, blew out the oil lamp, and went upstairs.
She had just lain down when urgent knocking came from downstairs, followed by a man’s voice: “Anyone there?”
Outside stood a young man, drenched from head to toe, a blood-stained bandage wrapped around his left arm. He said his name was Bai Yun, a member of the Azure Dragon Society.
“I need my wound dressed,” Bai Yun said quietly. “I can pay. Is three thousand five hundred wen enough?”
He took a letter wrapped in oilpaper from inside his robe: “This letter must reach Qingfeng before the eighteenth of May.”
As she bandaged the wound, he said with a bitter smile, “If my fiancée knew I was knocking on a young woman’s door in the middle of the night, she’d be jealous.”
Lin Xiaoyu did not take his money. She only said, “First thing tomorrow morning, I’ll take you up the mountain.”
2: They set out at dawn. Lin Xiaoyu carried a bamboo basket on her back, filled with dried food, medicinal herbs, and an old umbrella.

Halfway up the mountain, they met Zhou Dashan, an old man chopping firewood. He set down his axe and lowered his voice: the evening before, three outsiders had been asking about an injured young man at the town entrance.
"Xiaoyu, take the mountain trail," Zhou Dashan said. "The main road isn't safe." Lin Xiaoyu thanked him.
The trail was narrow and slippery. Lin Xiaoyu walked in front, each step planted firmly. Bai Yun followed behind without saying a word.
By noon the rain had stopped, and the mountain mist slowly lifted, revealing the roof of Qingfeng in the distance. A nun stood at the gate—Zhao Qiuyue, the nun in charge of receiving guests.
Zhao Qiuyue took the letter, glanced at the red seal on the flap, and nodded. "The abbess has been waiting for this letter for 2 years."
Bai Yun said to Lin Xiaoyu, "I owe you my life." Lin Xiaoyu smiled. "Then next time you come, help me fix the roof of my medicine shop." Bai Yun stayed at the temple.
In the evening, Lin Xiaoyu went down the mountain alone. By the time she reached home, it was already dark. She lit the lamp and sat behind the counter for a long time.
